title: Awkward moment awaits Australian PM with potential Putin photo

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has not ruled out appearing in a photo alongside Vladimir Putin but has vowed to voice his opposition to Russia’s Ukraine invasion. Mr Albanese said he would respect and consider the host nation China’s wishes if he were asked to appear in a “family photo” with other leaders, including the Russian president, at the upcoming APEC summit. The prime minister is set to jet off to Shenzhen for the economic forum after attending the Asean meeting and a Quad leaders summit in the Philippines.
